questions.question: 다음 중 짝지어진 관계가 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: '배고픈 : 굶주림'은 형용사-명사 관계이지만, '동의하다 : 동의'는 동사-명사 관계이므로 대응 관계가 맞지 않습니다.

options: They __________ a new computer in the office.
The leaves __________ from the trees in autumn.
Can I __________ your help with my homework?
The company will __________ production next year.
He always helps me, so I will __________ him someday.
questions.question:
다음 중 <보기>의 단어 및 표현이 들어갈 수 없는 것은?

<보기>
reward, set up, give back, ask for, double
questions.explanation: ②의 빈칸에는 '나뭇잎들은 가을에 나무에서 떨어진다'는 뜻이 되도록 fall이 들어가야 하므로 보기의 단어들이 들어갈 수 없습니다.

options: I read a great story about a clever girl. / My classroom is on the third story.
Let's play soccer after school. / He watched a play about friendship.
The movie's opening scene was amazing. / The final scene of the movie was shocking.
They laughed at the joke. / Her laugh is loud and happy.
Be kind to animals. / This kind of food is healthy.
questions.question: 다음 밑줄 친 단어가 같은 의미로 쓰인 것은?
questions.explanation: ③의 scene은 두 문장 모두에서 '장면'이라는 같은 의미로 사용되었습니다.

options: He cuts down the tree in the yard. (과거시제) → He cut down the tree in the yard.
He washed the car yesterday. (의문문) → Did he wash the car yesterday?
We did the right thing in that situation. (부정문) → We did not the right thing in that situation.
The trip was very interesting. (감탄문) → How interesting the trip was!
They run a small business in the city. (과거시제) → They ran a small business in the city.
questions.question: 다음 문장을 괄호 안의 지시대로 바꾼 것으로 알맞지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ③은 부정문이 '→ We did not do the right thing in that situation.'으로 고쳐져야 합니다. 'did not'을 사용하면 동사원형을 써야 합니다.

questions.question:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞지 않은 것을 모두 고르면?

G: Chris, what did you do yesterday?
B: I baked cookies with my brother.
G: How was it?
B: _______________ The cookies were sweet and soft.
questions.explanation: 빈칸 뒤에 '쿠키는 달콤하고 부드러웠다'는 긍정적 내용이 이어지므로, ① '일요일이었어!'와 ④ '바람이 불었어!'는 문맥상 맞지 않습니다.

options: Why did you like the book
What did you do last weekend
What will you do next weekend
What did you read last Saturday
What are you going to do this Sunday
questions.question:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 모두 고르면?

G: ________________________________, Sam?
B: I read The Little Prince in the library.
G: How was the book?
B: I liked it. The story was touching!
questions.explanation: 소년의 답변이 '도서관에서 어린 왕자를 읽었다'는 과거형이므로, 과거의 활동이나 독서 내용을 묻는 ② '지난 주말에 무엇을 했니'와 ④ '지난 토요일에 무엇을 읽었니'가 적절합니다.

questions.answer: set up a tent, watched the stars
questions.question:
다음 대화를 읽고 아래 질문에 대한 알맞은 대답이 되도록 주어진 <조건>에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하시오.

B: How was your weekend, Mia?
G: It was wonderful. I went camping with my family.
B: What did you do there?
G: We set up a tent and watched the stars at night. It was great.

<조건>
• 본문에서 찾아 쓸 것
• 각 빈칸에 한 단어씩 쓸 것

Q. What did Mia do during the camping trip? → She ___________ ___________ ___________ ___________ with her family and ___________ ___________ ___________ at night. ※ 각 빈칸에 한 단어씩 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 본문에서 'We set up a tent and watched the stars at night.'라는 문장을 찾아 쓰면 됩니다.

questions.answer: played soccer, watched[saw], The Blue Bird, story[acting], acting[story]
questions.question:
다음 대화의 내용을 아래와 같이 요약할 때, 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 말을 쓰시오.

Minji: What did you do last weekend, Junho?
Junho: I played soccer with my friends. How about you?
Minji: I watched a play with Kate.
Kate: Yeah, we saw The Blue Bird. Junho: I heard about that play. How was it?
Minji: It was amazing. The story was very interesting.
Kate: I agree. The acting was also great. I really enjoyed it.
Junho: That sounds great. Where did you see it?
Minji: We saw it at Happy Theater. You should watch it!
Junho: Okay, I will.

Last weekend, Junho and his friends ___________ ___________. Minji and Kate ___________ a play ___________ ___________ ___________. They think the ___________ and the ___________ in the play were good, and recommend it to Junho. ※ 각 빈칸에 한 단어씩 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 대화 내용을 정리하면 준호는 친구들과 축구를 했고, 민지와 Kate는 '파랑새'라는 연극을 보았으며, 연극의 이야기와 연기가 좋았다고 평가합니다.

questions.question:
다음 글을 읽고 물음에 답하시오.

The king called the servant on day 10.
King: How (A)[much / many] rice will Rani get today?
Servant: 512 grains.
King: (laughs) That's just a handful. She's not wise.
It was day 24.
Servant: Four elephants will carry the rice to Rani's house today. It's more than 8 million grains.
King: (in surprise) How many elephants will carry the rice on the last day?
Servant: 256 elephants. Your storehouse will (B)[be / is] empty.
King: Alas! I'm in trouble.
The king met Rani on the last day.
King: Whew.... What will you do with the rice?
Rani: I'll share it with the hungry people.
King: You're so kind.
Rani: I'll share some with you, too. However, don't be greedy anymore.
King: I won't! I won't!
Servant: (to himself) What a wise girl (C)[she is / is she]!

윗글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?
questions.explanation: (A) 셀 수 없는 명사 rice 앞에는 'much'를 사용합니다. (B) 'will' 뒤에는 동사원형 'be'가 옵니다. (C) 'What+a(n)+형용사+명사+주어+동사!'의 형태로 'she is'가 옳습니다.

questions.question:
다음 글을 읽고 물음에 답하시오.

The king called the servant on day 10.
King: How (A)[much / many] rice will Rani get today?
Servant: 512 grains.
King: (laughs) That's just a handful. She's not wise.
It was day 24.
Servant: Four elephants will carry the rice to Rani's house today. It's more than 8 million grains.
King: (in surprise) How many elephants will carry the rice on the last day?
Servant: 256 elephants. Your storehouse will (B)[be / is] empty.
King: Alas! I'm in trouble.
The king met Rani on the last day.
King: Whew.... What will you do with the rice?
Rani: I'll share it with the hungry people.
King: You're so kind.
Rani: I'll share some with you, too. However, don't be greedy anymore.
King: I won't! I won't!
Servant: (to himself) What a wise girl (C)[she is / is she]!

What lesson did the king learn from Rani?
questions.explanation: Rani는 마지막에 왕에게 더 이상 욕심부리지 말라고 조언하고, 왕은 이를 받아들입니다. 따라서 왕은 '욕심은 좋지 않다'는 교훈을 얻습니다.

questions.question:
다음 글을 읽고 물음에 답하시오.

Long ago, ⓐthere a greedy king lived. His people were hungry, but ⓑhe didn't share his rice with them. One day, an elephant was carrying bags of rice to the king. ⓒRice was falling from one of the bags. Rani saw it and thought for a while.
Rani: I have a good idea! (sits down and collects the rice)
Servant: What are you doing?
Rani: Oh, this rice isn't mine. ⓓI'll give them back to the king. The king heard about Rani.
King: ⓔHow honestly you are! I'll reward you. What do you want?
Rani: Your Highness, one grain of rice is enough.
King: Only one? You can ask for more.
Rani: Then I want one grain today, two tomorrow, and four the next day. ⓕDouble the rice each day for 30 days, please.
King: That's easy. (to the servant) Bring one grain of rice!
Servant: Yes, Your Highness.

윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓕ 중, 어법상 어색한 것끼리 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓐ 'there a greedy king lived' → 'lived a greedy king' (유도부사 there 뒤 도치), ⓓ 'I'll give them back' → 'I'll give it back' (this rice를 가리키므로 it), ⓔ 'How honestly you are' → 'How honest you are' (형용사 필요)

questions.question:
윗글을 읽고 나눈 대화가 다음과 같을 때, 밑줄 친 ㉠~㉤ 중 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

A: Minho, what are you reading?
B: I'm reading a story about Rani.
A: Is it fun?
B: Yes. People were hungry, but the king didn't share the rice. ㉠He was greedy.
A: Oh, no! Please tell me more about it.
B: ㉡A good idea came to Rani.
A: ㉢Rani returned the rice on the ground to the king and asked for one grain of rice as a reward.
B: Just one?
A: But she actually wanted one grain at first, and then ㉣asked for the same amount of the rice every day for 30 days.
B: Wow! That's a large amount!
A: You're right. But the king didn't know that and ㉤accepted her request.
B: I'm curious about the next part.
questions.explanation: ㉣은 '매일 같은 양의 쌀을 받는다'는 의미이나, 실제로는 매일 두 배씩 늘려 달라고 했으므로 글의 내용과 일치하지 않습니다.

questions.answer: will be empty on the last day
questions.question:
다음 글을 읽고, 아래 질문에 대한 알맞은 대답이 되도록 주어진 <조건>에 알맞게 빈칸을 완성하시오.

It was day 24.
Servant: Four elephants will carry the rice to Rani's house today. It's more than 8 million grains.
King: (in surprise) How many elephants will carry the rice on the last day?
Servant: 256 elephants. Your storehouse will be empty.
King: Alas! I'm in trouble.

Q. Why does the king say, "I'm in trouble"?

<조건>
• 본문에서 찾아 쓸 것
• 각 빈칸에 한 단어씩 쓸 것

→ Because he knew his storehouse ___________ ___________ ___________ ___________ ___________ ___________ ___________. ※ 각 빈칸에 한 단어씩 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 본문에서 'Your storehouse will be empty'라는 문장을 기반으로 '그의 창고가 마지막 날에 비게 될 것을 알았기 때문'이라는 의미로 완성합니다.

options: ⓐ: 유도부사 there가 문장 앞에 있어 'there+동사+주어'의 어순으로 쓰였다.
ⓑ: 과거진행형으로, 과거에 '운반하고 있던' 중임을 나타내고 있다.
ⓒ: 과거동사로, 과거동사 saw와 접속사 and로 대등하게 연결되었다.
ⓓ: 타동사 give와 부사 back이 구동사를 이루므로 대명사 it이 가운데에 쓰였다.
ⓔ: '어떻게'라는 뜻의 의문사로, 형용사 honest를 수식하고 있다.
questions.question:
다음 글을 읽고 물음에 답하시오.

Long ago, there ⓐlived a greedy king. (A)그의 백성들은 굶주렸지만, 그는 그의 쌀을 그들과 나누지 않았습니다. One day, an elephant ⓑwas carrying bags of rice to the king. Rice was falling from one of the bags. Rani saw it and ⓒthought for a while.
Rani: I have a good idea! (sits down and collects the rice)
Servant: What are you doing?
Rani: Oh, this rice isn't mine. I'll ⓓgive it back to the king.
The king heard about Rani.
King: ⓔHow honest you are! I'll reward you. What do you want?
Rani: Your Highness, one grain of rice is enough.
King: Only one? You can ask for more.
Rani: Then I want one grain today, two tomorrow, and four the next day. (B)_______________________
________________ for 30 days, please.
King: That's easy. (to the servant) Bring one grain of rice!
Servant: Yes, Your Highness.

윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ에 대한 설명으로 알맞지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓔ의 How는 '정말 ~하구나!'라는 뜻의 감탄문을 이루는 부사이지, '어떻게'라는 의문사가 아닙니다. 감탄문은 'How+형용사+주어+동사!'의 형태입니다.

questions.answer: His people were hungry, he didn't share his rice with them
questions.question:
윗글의 밑줄 친 (A)의 우리말을 주어진 <조건>에 알맞게 영작하시오.

(A)그의 백성들은 굶주렸지만, 그는 그의 쌀을 그들과 나누지 않았습니다.

<조건>
• people, hungry, share를 모두 사용할 것
• 각 빈칸에 한 단어씩 쓸 것

→ _________ _________ _________ _________, but _________
_________ _________ _________ _________ _________ _________. ※ 각 빈칸에 한 단어씩 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 주어 His people은 복수명사구이므로 be동사 were를 사용하고, 과거형 부정문은 'didn't+동사원형'으로 표현합니다.

options: Add one grain every other day
Keep the rice the same each day
Give people one grain of rice every day
questions.question: 윗글의 빈칸 (B)에 들어갈 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: Rani는 '오늘 한 톨, 내일 두 톨, 그 다음 날 네 톨'이라고 했으므로 매일 두 배씩 늘려 달라는 의미입니다.

options: What was falling from one of the bags?
What reward did Rani ask for first?
How did the king respond to Rani's first request?
What will Rani use the rice for?
questions.question: 윗글을 읽고 답할 수 없는 질문은?
questions.explanation: Rani가 무엇에 쌀을 사용할 것인지는 명시되어 있지 않으므로 답할 수 없습니다.

questions.question:
윗글의 내용과 (A)~(C)가 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 쓸 때, 순서대로 연결된 것은?

(A) The king was greedy and didn't help his starving people. (T/F)
(B) Because of Rani's honesty, the king offered a reward to her. (T/F)
(C) The king thought Rani's request was hard, so he refused it. (T/F)
questions.explanation: (A) T - 왕은 욕심이 많았고 백성들을 도주지 않았습니다. (B) T - Rani의 정직함 때문에 왕은 보상을 제안했습니다. (C) F - 왕은 요청이 쉽다고 생각했고 수락했습니다(거절하지 않음).

options: She returns it to the servant.
She sit down and collects it.
She gathers it and takes it home.
She gives the rice to hungry people.
She doesn't care and just walks away.
questions.question: Rani가 땅에 떨어진 쌀을 본 후에 한 행동으로 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: 본문에서 'Rani saw it and thought for a while. Rani: I have a good idea! (sits down and collects the rice)'라고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.answer: one grain of rice, double, each day, 30 days
questions.question:
윗글을 읽고 다음 질문에 대한 알맞은 대답이 되도록 빈칸을 완성하시오.

Q. What reward will the king give to Rani? → The king will give __________ _________ _________ __________ to her on the first day and _________ the rice _________ _________ for _________ _________. ※ 각 빈칸에 한 단어씩 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: Rani의 요청에 따라 왕은 첫 날에 쌀 한 톨을 주고, 30일 동안 매일 두 배씩 늘려줄 것입니다.

options: The King Gave Away All His Rice!
The King's Wisdom Saved the Elephants!
Rani's Good Idea against the Greedy King
The Honest Servant and the Hungry People
questions.question: 윗글의 제목으로 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: Rani가 욕심 많은 왕을 상대로 자신의 좋은 생각(쌀을 두 배씩 늘려달라)으로 왕을 깨우친다는 내용이 핵심입니다.

questions.question:
다음 글을 읽고 물음에 답하시오.

The king heard about Rani.
King: How honest you are! I'll reward you. What do you want?
Rani: Your Highness, one grain of rice is enough.
King: Only one? You can ask for more.
Rani: Then I want one grain today, two tomorrow, and four the next day. Double the rice each day for 30 days, please.
King: That's easy. (to the servant) Bring one grain of rice!
Servant: Yes, Your Highness.

The king called the servant on day 10.
King: How much rice will Rani ⓐgets today?
Servant: 512 grains.
King: (laughs) That's just a handful. She's not wise.
It was day 24.
Servant: Four elephants will carry the rice to Rani's house today. It's more than 8 million grains.
King: (in surprise) How ⓑmuch elephants will carry the rice on the last day?
Servant: 256 elephants. Your storehouse will be empty.
King: Alas! I'm in trouble.

The king ⓒmeets Rani on the last day.
King: Whew.... What will you do with the rice?
Rani: I'll share it with the hungry people.
King: You're so kind.
Rani: I'll share some with you, too. However, don't ⓓgreedy anymore.
King: I won't! I won't!
Servant: (to himself) ⓔHow a wise girl she is!

윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ를 바르게 고치지 못한 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓒ의 'meets'는 과거시제로 'met'으로 고쳐야 하는데, 'meeted'는 불규칙 동사이므로 올바른 과거형이 아닙니다. 'meets → met'으로 고쳐야 합니다.

questions.question:
다음 글을 읽고 물음에 답하시오.

The king heard about Rani.
King: How honest you are! I'll reward you. What do you want?
Rani: Your Highness, one grain of rice is enough.
King: Only one? You can ask for more.
Rani: Then I want one grain today, two tomorrow, and four the next day. Double the rice each day for 30 days, please.
King: That's easy. (to the servant) Bring one grain of rice!
Servant: Yes, Your Highness.

The king called the servant on day 10.
King: How much rice will Rani gets today?
Servant: 512 grains.
King: (laughs) That's just a handful. She's not wise.
It was day 24.
Servant: Four elephants will carry the rice to Rani's house today. It's more than 8 million grains.
King: (in surprise) How much elephants will carry the rice on the last day?
Servant: 256 elephants. Your storehouse will be empty.
King: Alas! I'm in trouble.

How many elephants should the king use on day 25?
questions.explanation: 24일째에 4마리의 코끼리가 필요했으므로, 25일째에는 두 배인 8마리의 코끼리가 필요합니다.

options: How to Count Rice with Elephants
The Wisdom in a Handful of Rice Grains
questions.question: 윗글의 제목으로 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: 작은 쌀 한 톨에서 시작한 Rani의 지혜가 왕의 욕심을 깨우쳤다는 의미에서 '한 줌의 쌀알에 담긴 지혜'가 가장 적절합니다.

questions.question:
윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것의 개수는?

㉠ On day 10, Rani received 512 grains of rice.
㉡ On day 24, four elephants carried the rice to the king.
㉢ The king's storehouse was already empty on day 24.
㉣ Rani shared the rice with the hungry, but she didn't give any to the king.
㉤ According to Rani's advice, the king would no longer be greedy.
㉥ The servant was angry at Rani's rudeness.
questions.explanation: 일치하는 것: ㉠(10일차에 512톨), ㉤(Rani의 조언대로 왕은 욕심을 부리지 않겠다고 말함). 불일치: ㉡(Rani에게), ㉢(마지막 날에 비게 될 예정), ㉣(배고픈 사람들과 왕 모두에게 나눠줌), ㉥(감탄함)

questions.question:
윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ의 영영풀이로 알맞은 것을 모두 골라 짝지은 것은?

<보기>
ⓐ a person with work for a king or rich family
ⓑ a large amount
ⓒ the number 1000,000
ⓓ a building for putting and saving food or other things

questions.explanation: ⓐ servant - 왕이나 부잣집에서 일하는 사람, ⓒ million - 1,000,000, ⓓ storehouse - 음식이나 물건을 보관하는 건물.

questions.answer: easy, 512, Four elephants, in trouble, 256 elephants, greedy
questions.question:
윗글을 다음과 같이 요약할 때, 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 말을 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오.

Rani's Wisdom
Day 1
Rani got one grain of rice. → The king thought her request was ___________.
Day 10
She got ___________ grains. → The king laughed. He thought it was too small.
Day 24
___________ ___________ carried more than 8 million grains to her house. → The king realized he was ___________ ___________.
Day 30
___________ ___________ carried all of the king's rice to her house. → The king says, "I won't be ___________ anymore." ※ 각 빈칸에 한 단어씩 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 본문의 내용에 따라 요약 칸을 채우면: Day 1은 쉽다(easy), Day 10은 512톨, Day 24는 네 마리 코끼리가 곤경에(in trouble), Day 30은 256마리 코끼리가 욕심쟁이(greedy)를 의미합니다.
